intended: pred used[u: Unit] { (some v: Unit | v != u and cites[v, u]) or (some p: Pointer | p->u in Name.pointer) or (some g: Tag | g->u in Name.tag) }
why: The formula only counts a unit as used when another unit sits in it (Sit.rel alone), but s000 defines cites as sitting-in OR deriving-from, and the rationale is about anything that relies on the unit. A unit cited only via a 'Derives from:' line without being nested under it is wrongly left not-used: e.g. spec S has 'Derives from: F' but does not sit in F, and no pointer or tag names F — F is marked not used even though S relies on it, which would flip under cites[v,u].
